svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Express & Postman · Success responses · All URI paths include the /api prefix
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
Sign in and set JWT cookie
Update own name and optional city
List own campaigns in all states
Success codes: 200 = returned/updated; 201 = created; 204 = no content. Logout clears the session cookie.
Organization saves accept multipart data + optional image; removeImage removes a logo. Changes return the profile to pending review.
JWT and CSRF protect mutations. Only volunteer/organizer signup is public; admin accounts are seeded.
